title: established colour conventions
name: Established colour conventions
rule: Established colour conventions override the theme palette — traffic light risk, party colours, water/vegetation, finance red/black. Still label/pattern so colour is not the only channel. Do not generalize the exception.
pass_when: Domain conventions (risk/party/land/finance) override theme; colour is not the only channel.
fail_when: Theme palette used where a named convention applies, or colour is the only channel.
overview: Domain colour conventions override theme; never rely on colour alone.
apply_when: Charts using risk, party, land, water, vegetation, or finance colours.
not_when: Theme palette where a named convention applies, or colour-only encoding.
agent_hint: Honor domain colour conventions over theme; always add label or pattern channels.
